name: tap-out
description: TAP / OUT - a wilderness survival competition game for Windows.

scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run start --workspace @tapout/desktop
scripts.package:win: npm run build && npm run package:win --workspace @tapout/desktop
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/content && tsc -p packages/harness && tsc -p apps/game && tsc -p tests
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
